name: gate-state-resolution
title: Resolve a gate state to its three meanings in both Builds views
outcome: A gate line reads as approved, as not applicable, or as open in both Builds views, and a view opens only a document that the plan holds.
done_when: The static page for `skill-collision-fix` opens no document that plan does not hold
A plan that holds `interaction-design.md` draws a rail button labelled with a real title, and the text `undefined` appears nowhere in a rendered page
An `n/a` gate carries a closed treatment in the static page and in the viewer rail, and neither view describes it as in progress
The viewer rail header states the number of approved gates out of the total
abort_if: The two renderers need two different meanings for one gate state
Closing the missing-document path needs a new stored field on the gate record

min_work.derived_from: 2 plugin files, 1 generated page, 2 test files, and five faults reproduced by running the generator against this repository
min_work.note: Design mode did not run for this feature, and this record was written by hand on 2026-09-14. `shared/build_index.py` reads epic identity only from this file, so without it the slices in `docs/plans/gate-state-resolution/04-slices.md` stayed unresolved and `uv run shared/build_index.py` printed warnings. This file therefore holds the minimum that the index and the Builds view read: the outcome, the epic registry, and the stage. The companion files design mode writes, `intent.json`, `assessment.json`, `narrative.json`, `pr-draft.md`, and `diagrams/`, are absent on purpose. The appended section of ADR-0024 holds the reasoning and the three rejected alternatives.

epics.note: Teach both Builds views the three meanings of a gate state. `is_resolved(state)` in `plugins/artifact/scripts/build_builds_view.py` holds the test, and `current_doc()` receives the document map filtered to the files the plan holds, so a returned document always exists. The static page gains the `na` treatment and stops printing the text `undefined` for a Gate 2b document. The viewer rail gains the `is-na` card class, the `na` pill class, the words "Not applicable", and a header count of approved gates. Slices 1 and 2.

rounds.note: Not a design-mode round. The user chose one plan with the two slices, chose subagent implementation, and chose an addendum to ADR-0024 over a new ADR-0025. The slice split moved from fault ownership to file ownership, because two agents must not edit one file.
